purpose: Prevent repeated multi-hour debugging loops from consuming Cart 2.0 wall-clock time without lifecycle progress.
milestone_definition: candidate install/recovery completed and identity verified
Phase 2 lane reaches a defined deliverable/acceptance gate

at_30_minutes_without_material_milestone: STOP the current mechanism at the next safe boundary.
Preserve evidence and classify the failure domain.
Do not continue tuning the same mechanism.
Pivot to a materially different mechanism or to an independent ready lane.
retry_rule: One retry maximum per failure class.
A retry is legal only when the mechanism materially changes and the new evidence explains why the retry should succeed.
Parameter-only tweaking of the same failed mechanism is not a new mechanism.
at_60_minutes_without_lifecycle_progress: The blocked lane may continue only if it is inside a required healthy long-running gate.
Otherwise it loses monopoly on wall-clock time.
Activate every offline-safe independent Cart 2.0 lane that is ready.
build_and_actions: Do not rebuild firmware or use GitHub Actions for host, transport, harness, telemetry-reader, or orchestration defects unless the existing artifact itself is invalidated.
Prefer exact existing artifacts and local/direct mechanisms.
attempt_contract: Before each live attempt record start time, 30-minute checkpoint, hard exit condition, material milestone target, failure class, and fallback mechanism.
A worker may not enter an open-ended debug loop.
required_long_running_gate_exception: An explicitly required long-running gate such as the >=90-minute Foundation soak is not a stall while it is demonstrably running and healthy.
During such a gate, parallel offline-safe lanes must still activate as soon as their activation condition is satisfied.
A healthy soak must not be interrupted solely because 30 or 60 minutes elapsed.
reporting: Report elapsed wall-clock against milestone targets, not commit/test activity.
If a budget expires, record the pivot and reason in durable authority.

current_seq39_application.rule: Apply prospectively to the active seq39 Foundation transaction. If the active sweep/observer path stops producing a required material milestone for 30 minutes, preserve evidence and pivot. If Foundation has not advanced lifecycle within 60 minutes and no healthy required long-running gate is running, activate offline-safe Phase 2 lanes.
current_seq39_application.soak_rule: Once the >=90-minute soak is actually running and healthy, keep it running and activate offline-safe Phase 2 lanes after the existing clean-sample readiness signal.
